text:
anya.design: Dropping a tiny thread for the 'Aurora' dark theme pass. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/aurora-token-pass 
zoe.design: Nice direction. Two quick probs: inline code at 12px is faint; overlapping chart lines on mobile collapse. :mag:
mike.eng: For charts we prefer changing hexes over halos for perf. Can you paste the tokens?
anya.design: tokens: --bg:#061015, --panel:#0d1316, --muted:#98a8ae, --text:#e9f4f6, --code-bg:#071217, --code-fg:#bfeaff, --a1:#23b09a, --a2:#ff6c58, --a3:#f2b600
keiko.a11y: Contrast quick-check: --muted on --panel = 3.1:1 (fails AA). code-fg on code-bg = 4.8:1 (marginal inline). Recommend bumping muted to ~#c6d7db.
luis.data: Colorblind sim: a1 vs a2 low separation in protanopia. Suggest a1:#00b39f a2:#ff5a50 — keeps luminance gap for canvas.
tom.frontend: Option: token bump now (easy) + inline code pill later. That avoids renderer work.
anya.design: Good plan. I'll update tokens to --muted:#c6d7db, a1/a2 as suggested, add --focus-ring:#ffd86b and open a PR. Tagging @keiko.a11y for the smoke checklist.
design-bot: Comment created on frame 'Aurora Charts' by anya.design: "Token PR incoming; accessibility and CVD tests requested."
anya.design: Thanks all. If no objections by EOD I'll merge the token changes.
